verdict.rationale: Composio's CLI and meta-tools let an agent/developer discover available toolkits, inspect tool schemas, and execute tools (composio-docs-10, composio-docs-14, composio-docs-24), and creating an MCP server lets you specify allowed_tools per toolkit (composio-docs-23), implying visibility into what tools exist. But there's no documented registry view showing transport type or hosting attributes for listed servers before connecting — discovery is framed as runtime tool/toolkit lookup rather than a browsable server catalog with schema/transport/hosting metadata upfront. Missing for 10: a registry UI or API listing servers with explicit transport and hosting attributes, and pre-connection schema browsing independent of session creation.
